editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Dukascopy Bank scores 7.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. A FINMA-regulated Swiss bank — not just a broker — offering ECN trading via the SWFX marketplace with spreads from 0.1 pips and $7 round-turn commission. CHF 100,000 deposit protection under esisuisse for the Swiss entity, EU coverage via Bank of Latvia with MiFID II passporting. Clean regulatory record across 20+ years. The trade-off: wire-only withdrawals, a CHF 100/year inactivity fee, and a JForex platform that rewards technical traders while punishing casual ones. Legitimate and safe — built for traders who prioritise institutional-grade security over convenience.
